title: Wild stock market swings: will I lose money, and is there anything I can do?
summary: Shares are volatile amid jitters over tech and AI – but think carefully before you decide to ditch investments too It has been a volatile time on global stock markets, with rapid rallies and punishing sell-offs. There have been signs in recent weeks that investors are getting cold feet over the outlook for AI companies and selling off technology stocks. Last week, the AI company Anthropic launched on to the market and had a record-breaking first day , but on Friday stock markets around the world tumbled and the US Nasdaq closed 5% below its mark on 1 January .
